title: Vagabond RV Park

services.name: RV site
services.desc: We have 22 full hookup RV sites available (mostly 30 amp service, with a couple 15 amp service). The sites are spread out throughout the park with 7 spots in the open field and 15 spots in between the trees. Most sites have their own picnic table. Vagabond RV Park offers spacious RV sites designed for comfort and convenience. Our park welcomes travellers seeking a quiet, scenic destination while exploring the Chilcotin and Bella Coola regions. Guests enjoy beautiful lake views, easy access to outdoor recreation, and a friendly atmosphere that keeps visitors returning year after year.
